title: 36, 85, 14: three numbers that explain the enterprise AI gap
script:
Thirty-six percent of organizations seeing real returns identified clean, accessible data as their strongest predictor of success.
Eighty-five percent is the reduction in underwriting turnaround time some AI-assisted credit platforms are now reporting.
Fourteen percent of organizations have built a genuinely unified view of the customer, according to Gartner.
The CIO report highlights a massive gap between testing tools and real business value.
Companies struggle to move from simple pilot programs to full organizational integration.
Scaling requires clean data and a cultural shift in how internal teams operate.
Can your company bridge this gap or will it stay stuck at fourteen percent?
